title: Herbed Thai Mackerel Curry
description: A vibrant Thai-style curry with tender mackerel, fresh herbs, and a creamy cheese custard that melts into a silky sauce. This pescatarian-friendly dish blends traditional flavors with a modern twist.
instructions: Heat a large saucepan over medium and pour in coconut milk, heavy cream, and fish sauce; bring to a gentle simmer.
Add sliced red Thai chilies, kaffir lime leaves, and a pinch of salt; stir for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Season the mackerel fillets with salt and place them in a small pot of boiling water to blanch for 30 seconds; remove and pat dry.
Transfer the blanched fillets into the simmering sauce and cook for 4 minutes until they are just opaque.
Stir in the grated parmesan cheese until fully melted and the sauce thickens slightly.
Reduce the heat to low and fold in the fresh basil, cilantro, and mint leaves until wilted.
Add lime juice and adjust seasoning with additional fish sauce if needed.
Serve the curry over steamed jasmine rice or cauliflower rice for a lower-carb option.
Garnish with extra herbs and a sprinkle of parmesan for a cheesy pull effect.
Let the dish sit for 2 minutes before serving to allow flavors to meld.
